aboutDescription: O Tempora is an interactive timeline of world history — People, Conflicts, and Milestones, spanning ~800 BCE to the present.
aboutCodeBody: This site's source code is open source, licensed under the MIT License.
aboutDataPeopleBody: People data is drawn from Pantheon 2.0 by Datawheel, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Descriptions are additionally sourced from Wikidata (CC0).
aboutDataEventsBody: Conflicts and Milestones data is drawn from Wikidata, dedicated to the public domain under CC0.
detailLevelDescription.legendary: Only top-tier, world-altering figures, major conflicts, and pivotal milestones.
detailLevelDescription.mainstream: Essential historical figures, key conflicts, and primary milestones.
detailLevelDescription.specialized: Includes notable figures, secondary conflicts, and regional milestones.
detailLevelDescription.deep-cut: Displays high-density details, including niche figures, minor conflicts, and obscure milestones.
landingPitch: People, conflicts and milestones from about 800 BCE to today share one axis, so you can see who lived at the same time.
landingCase.einstein-jobs.lede: Albert Einstein and Steve Jobs were alive at the same time.
landingCase.einstein-jobs.caption: Jobs was born in February 1955. Einstein died two months later, in April.
landingCase.monet-monroe.lede: Claude Monet was still alive when Marilyn Monroe and Queen Elizabeth II were born.
landingCase.monet-monroe.caption: Elizabeth II was born in April 1926, Monroe in June, and Monet died in December.
landingCase.ali-hawking.lede: Muhammad Ali and Stephen Hawking were born in the same month.
landingCase.ali-hawking.caption: Both in January 1942. Aretha Franklin followed in March and Jimi Hendrix in November.
landingCase.class-of-1940.lede: Pelé, Bruce Lee and John Lennon were born within two months of each other.
landingCase.class-of-1940.caption: Lennon and Pelé in October 1940, Lee in November.
landingCase.year-1564.lede: Michelangelo died the month Galileo was born. Shakespeare arrived two months later.
landingCase.year-1564.caption: February 1564: Michelangelo's life ends and Galileo's begins. Shakespeare was born in April.
landingCase.jefferson-adams.lede: John Adams and Thomas Jefferson, the second and third presidents of the United States, died in the same month.
landingCase.jefferson-adams.caption: Both died in July 1826, aged 90 and 83.
landingCase.kaiser.lede: The German Kaiser of the First World War was still alive when the Second began.
landingCase.kaiser.caption: Wilhelm II died in June 1941, twenty-one months after the Second World War began.
landingCase.victoria-napoleon.lede: Queen Victoria was born two years before Napoleon died.
landingCase.victoria-napoleon.caption: Victoria was born in May 1819 and Napoleon died in May 1821. She lived until 1901.
landingCase.joan-vlad.lede: Vlad the Impaler was born the year Joan of Arc died, with the Hundred Years' War still going.
landingCase.joan-vlad.caption: Joan died in May 1431 and Vlad was born in November. The war had begun 94 years earlier and ended in 1453.
landingFooterData: Data from Pantheon 2.0, Wikidata and Wikipedia.
